name: Camouflaged Spiked Pit
description: A 20-foot deep, funnel-shaped pit with dozens of wooden spikes lining its walls.
disable: Yanking the cloth away is a simple way to expose the danger to allow someone to merely avoid it by walking around its edges, but it cannot be quickly disabled.
reset: Creatures can still fall into the trap once it has been exposed, but the camouflaged cover must be reset manually for the trap to become hidden again.

generalAbilities.name: Spiked Pitfall
generalAbilities.description:
Trigger A creature walks onto one of the pits

Effect The triggering creature falls and rolls through several spikes as it slides to the bottom. This inflicts 5 Bludgeoning Damage damage from the fall itself down the steep slope (the falling PC can't attempt to Grab an Edge due to the lack of defined edges to the pit's walls), but the falling PC must also attempt a DC 26 Reflex Saving Throw save.

Critical Success The character avoids all of the spikes and takes no additional damage.

Success The character takes (2d10+11) Piercing Damage damage from the spikes.

Failure The character takes (4d10+22) Piercing Damage damage from the spikes.

Critical Failure The character takes (4d10+22) Piercing Damage damage from the spikes plus 2d6 Bleed Damage damage. While the character is taking this bleed damage, they are also Sickened 2 from the pain.
